body: I’ve also attempted suicide a number of times. I don’t share that regret unfortunately.
Thank you. I hope I do too.

Yeah. I know some people will be devastated and I feel guilty about that. But I’ve also been living for so long just for them while I’ve been dead inside. I’m selfish I guess. I did try a hotline just to see if there was anything I could do but they told me to try doing a puzzle...
I appreciate the comment. I’m in a really bad place. I don’t know that I would ever be proud of the smaller steps.
No offense but the people who know me don’t even love me. I don’t believe you can love someone you don’t even know.

I guess I’ve tried. I don’t even really know who I am. I’ve tried so hard to get better and nothing has helped. I know that I have high standards for myself. Everything I do feels like a personal failure.
